build_mmdet_backbone: build an MMDetBackbone wrapper to use mmdetection backbones in detectron2 with configurable neck and output shapes
create_mmdet_detector: create an MMDetDetector wrapper to run mmdetection detectors for detection and instance segmentation in detectron2
test_convert_mmdet_result: test the _convert_mmdet_result function to convert mmdetection results into detectron2 Instances objects
summarize_parse_losses: summarize the _parse_losses function that parses mmdetection loss dicts into log variables and metrics
refactor_to_container: refactor the _to_container helper to convert omegaconf DictConfig objects to mmdet ConfigDict containers
